name: Abyssal Ghost
description: Once upon a time, there was a pirate war that lasted for several years in the mysterious sea. The entire sea area was dyed red with blood. The resentment of countless pirates' undead souls sank into the sea, and finally gathered on a dilapidated warship. The undead gave the ruined ship a strange new life. The undead Siren awakened and it would devour everything it saw...
